context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles uncommitted changes when isolating work to a new Git worktree: explicitly acknowledging dirty state before acting, documenting a deliberate decision about what to do with those changes, using a named task branch, verifying the new worktree, and avoiding anti-patterns such as silently stashing, resetting, or bulk-copying the entire checkout directory.

checklist.name: Dirty state acknowledged
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md explicitly notes that uncommitted changes exist in the working directory before any worktree creation step (references lib/parser.py and/or config/defaults.yaml, or describes modified/dirty files in the current checkout)

checklist.name: Transfer decision documented
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md contains an explicit decision about what will happen to the uncommitted changes (e.g., leave them in the main checkout, carry them selectively, create a WIP commit, etc.) and provides reasoning for that choice

checklist.name: No bulk checkout copy
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md does NOT show or describe copying the entire repository directory (e.g., cp -r, rsync, or similar wholesale copy of the checkout) as the method for establishing the isolated workspace

checklist.name: Named task branch
checklist.description: The new worktree is created on a named branch (hotfix/null-check or similar descriptive name, not detached HEAD), as shown by the commands or output in repo/isolation-plan.md

checklist.name: Worktree verified
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md shows verification of the new worktree after creation (e.g., output of git worktree list, git status run inside the new worktree, or git rev-parse confirming the correct commit and path)

checklist.name: Worktree location convention
checklist.description: The new worktree path follows the <repo>/.worktrees/<task-name> convention (e.g., repo/.worktrees/hotfix-null-check), visible in the commands or paths shown in repo/isolation-plan.md

checklist.name: Git commands shown
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md includes the actual git worktree add command (or equivalent harness command) used to create the isolated workspace — not just a prose description of what was done

checklist.name: Selective transfer if applied
checklist.description: If any uncommitted changes are carried to the new worktree, repo/isolation-plan.md shows a deliberate, selective method (e.g., git diff > patch.diff and patch application, cherry-pick from a WIP commit, or explicit copy of named files) rather than wholesale directory duplication

checklist.name: Hotfix work isolated to worktree
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md states or clearly implies that subsequent hotfix commits and work will proceed inside the new worktree path, keeping them separate from the in-progress changes remaining in the main checkout

checklist.name: No undocumented destructive operation
checklist.description: repo/isolation-plan.md does NOT show git reset --hard, git checkout ., git restore ., or git stash used silently (without prior acknowledgment of the uncommitted changes and a documented decision to discard or set them aside)
